up: Return a listing of all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2163248. For each molecule, provide the following details: the molecule's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum development phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES string.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163248'
